    • getPressureCheckpointLimit

      @Nullable public Integer getPressureCheckpointLimit()
      The maximum number of indexing checkpoints that a replica shard can fall behind when copying from primary. Once `segrep.pressure.checkpoint.limit` is breached along with `segrep.pressure.time.limit`, the segment replication backpressure mechanism is initiated. Default is 4 checkpoints. minimum: 0
      Returns:
      pressureCheckpointLimit

    • getPressureReplicaStaleLimit

      @Nullable public BigDecimal getPressureReplicaStaleLimit()
      The maximum number of stale replica shards that can exist in a replication group. Once `segrep.pressure.replica.stale.limit` is breached, the segment replication backpressure mechanism is initiated. Default is .5, which is 50% of a replication group. minimum: 0 maximum: 1
      Returns:
      pressureReplicaStaleLimit

    • getPressureTimeLimit

      @Nullable public String getPressureTimeLimit()
      The maximum amount of time that a replica shard can take to copy from the primary shard. Once segrep.pressure.time.limit is breached along with segrep.pressure.checkpoint.limit, the segment replication backpressure mechanism is initiated. Default is 5 minutes.
      Returns:
      pressureTimeLimit
